missions.title: C1 Research Defense

realWorldScenarios.title: University Research Seminar
realWorldScenarios.description: Analyse several viewpoints on a complex question, identify the strongest evidence, formulate a qualified position, and defend it during a seminar discussion.

realWorldScenarios.title: Evidence Review Panel
realWorldScenarios.description: Review competing claims for a public-facing report, assess source reliability, identify limitations, and produce a concise evidence-based recommendation.

realWorldScenarios.title: Academic Conference Defense
realWorldScenarios.description: Present a research-informed argument to a demanding audience, answer challenging questions, qualify conclusions, and explain what further evidence is needed.
